messages.content: Thank you for taking the time to meet with me today. To start, I would like to understand the high-level goals for the modernised University Library Management System. Can you describe what you hope to achieve with this new system?

Thanks for having me! Well, I really just want things to be easier for students. Like, it would be great if we didn't have to queue at the library desk all the time. And, you know, being able to book study rooms from our phones would be super helpful. Also, getting reminders for returning books would definitely help us not forget. So, it's all about making things simpler and more convenient for everyone!

Thank you for sharing your thoughts. It sounds like the main goal is to enhance convenience for students by reducing queues and enabling mobile access. Let me clarify a few points to ensure I fully understand your needs.

You mentioned wanting to book study rooms from phones. Can you elaborate on how you envision this booking process? What specific features would you find helpful in that process?

Sure! I think it should just be really straightforward, you know? Like, you should be able to pick a date and a time easily. It would be great if you could see which rooms are available right there on your phone. And maybe if you could choose how many people will be in the room, that would help too. Just something that you can do without having to go to the library or anything complicated like that!

That makes sense. To summarise, you would like the study room booking feature to be straightforward, allowing students to easily select a date and time, view room availability, and specify the number of people using the room—all from their mobile devices. 

Now, regarding the loan management aspect you mentioned earlier, could you provide more details on what specific functionalities you would like in relation to book loans? For example, how would you like the process of borrowing and returning books to be managed in this new system?

Oh, definitely! I think it should be super easy to borrow and return books online. Like, you shouldn't have to go to the desk at all. Just a few clicks on your phone, and you’re done! 

And it would be awesome if you could see what you currently have borrowed and when it's due, so you know if you need to return anything. I guess just making the whole process quick and simple, without any fuss, would be what I’d love to see!

I appreciate your input. To summarise, you would like the loan management system to allow students to borrow and return books completely online, without needing to visit the library desk. Additionally, you want the ability to view currently borrowed items along with their due dates, making it easy to keep track of what needs to be returned.

Now, let's discuss the renewal process for borrowed books. What specific features or functionalities would you like to see implemented for renewing loans?

Oh, for renewing loans, I think it should just be simple too! Like, if you have a book and you want to keep it a bit longer, there should be an easy button or something to just renew it online. You know, like a quick click to extend the due date without having to go to the library. Just something that helps us avoid any late fees and keeps it hassle-free!

Thank you for that clarification. To summarise, you envision the renewal process as having a simple online button that allows students to easily extend the due date of borrowed books, helping to avoid late fees and making the experience hassle-free.

Moving on to the fines and penalty aspect, could you describe any specific functionalities you would like to see regarding fine collection and management in the new system? What would be important for you in this area?

Yeah, so about fines, I think it would be good if the system could just automatically let you know if you have any overdue books and if there are fines. Like, maybe a reminder before the due date so we don’t forget! 

And if there are fines, it should show you how much you owe right there on your phone. Just keeping everything clear and easy to understand, you know? It would be nice not to be surprised by anything when I try to borrow or book something!

Thank you for sharing your thoughts on the fine management process. To summarise, you would like the system to automatically notify students of any overdue books and associated fines, ideally with reminders before the due date. Additionally, you want to be able to view the total amount owed directly on your phone, ensuring clarity and preventing any surprises when borrowing or booking services.

Based on our discussion, I believe we have gathered enough requirements for the modernised University Library Management System. Here are the key points:

1. A straightforward study room booking process that allows students to select dates, times, view availability, and specify the number of people—all from their mobile devices.
2. An online loan management system that enables students to borrow and return books without visiting the library desk, along with the ability to view currently borrowed items and their due dates.
3. A simple online renewal process with a quick button to extend due dates for borrowed books to avoid late fees.
4. An automated reminder system for overdue books and fines, with notifications sent before due dates, along with a clear display of outstanding amounts on students' phones.
